integrity: Symbolic argument plus finite stdlib verifier. Finite checks do not replace proof. Literature priority remains conditional on the inspected source set.
scientific_limitations: Exact zero counts only for powers of two of exponent at least six; an explicit valuation identity is proved on indices divisible by twenty-eight; the remaining three 2-adic addresses are not classified. The general period-lifting method is already published.
title: Eleven zero classes for Narayana numbers modulo every large power of two
